description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class MaintenanceServiceTest for testing the MaintenanceService class in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It sets up mock services, populates test data, and verifies numerous functionalities such as accessing employee data, related entities, and purgeable entities.

classes.name: MaintenanceServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of MaintenanceService related to employee data retrieval, purgeable entities, and access strategy within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the MaintenanceService instance, loads test fixture data, and sets up mock services for testing.

methods.name: testAccessEmployeeData
methods.description: Validates the detailed retrieval of employee data and related entities, checking various fields against expected values.

methods.name: testReportTo
methods.description: Checks that supervisor-subordinate reporting data is correctly retrieved.

methods.name: testEmpPicture
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of employee picture data.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of employee attachment data.

methods.name: testEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Validates employee emergency contact information retrieval.

methods.name: testEmpWorkExperience
methods.description: Ensures work experience records are fetched correctly.

methods.name: testUser
methods.description: Retrieves and verifies user account data.

methods.name: testLeaveComment
methods.description: Verifies leave comments made by users and employees.

methods.name: testAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Ensures attendance punch records are correctly fetched.

methods.name: testPerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Checks logs related to performance tracking.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Verifies the list of database entities eligible for purge based on GDPR policies.

methods.name: testGetAccessStrategy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of access strategy objects for entities.
